TranscendenceExtension.name: TX Test Bot
TranscendenceExtension.Globals:
(block Nil (setq txBotLog (lambda (kind msg) (printTo 'log (cat "TXBOT: " kind " " msg)) ))
(setq txBotPass (lambda () (typIncData &evTxTestBot; 'pass 1)))
(setq txBotFail (lambda (what err) (block Nil (typIncData &evTxTestBot; 'fail 1) (txBotLog "FAIL" (cat what " :: " err)) ) ))
; Runs fn; logs a failure if it returns an error, or Nil when mustReturn is True. Returns fn's value or Nil. (setq txBotTry (lambda (what fn mustReturn) (block (result) (setq result (errblock (err) (fn) (block Nil (txBotFail what err) 'txBotFailed))) (switch (eq result 'txBotFailed) Nil
(and mustReturn (not result)) (block Nil (txBotFail what "returned Nil") Nil)
(block Nil (txBotPass) result) ) ) ))
; UNIDs are logged as #int; tx_testbot.py turns them into hex in its report (setq txBotHex (lambda (u) (cat "#" u))) (setq txBotName (lambda (u) (cat (txBotHex u) " " (or (typGetProperty u 'name) ""))))
(setq txBotInFocus (lambda (u) (filter txBotFocus r (and (geq u (@ r 0)) (leq u (@ r 1)))) ))
(setq txBotFar (lambda (angle dist) (sysVectorPolarOffset gPlayerShip angle dist)))
(setq txBotGet (lambda (key) (typGetData &evTxTestBot; key))) (setq txBotSet (lambda (key value) (typSetData &evTxTestBot; key value))) (setq txBotNext (lambda (phase) (block Nil (txBotSet 'phase phase) (txBotSet 'idx 0) (txBotLog "PHASE" phase) ) ))
; Removes everything the bot spawned that still exists. (setq txBotCleanup (lambda () (block Nil (enum (txBotGet 'spawned) id (block (obj) (setq obj (objGetObjByID id)) (if obj (errblock (err) (objRemove obj) Nil)) )) (txBotSet 'spawned Nil) ) ))
(setq txBotTrack (lambda (obj) (if obj (txBotSet 'spawned (append (txBotGet 'spawned) (list (objGetID obj))))) ))
; --- immortal (default): each second the damage taken is counted, then armor is repaired and shields ; recharged, so the run is not ended by the player dying (tx_testbot.py --mortal turns this off) (setq txBotKeepAlive (lambda () (if (and gPlayerShip (isBound 'txBotImmortal) txBotImmortal) (block (dmg) (setq dmg 0) (for seg 0 (subtract (shpGetArmorCount gPlayerShip) 1) (block (d) (setq d (or (objGetArmorDamage gPlayerShip seg) 0)) (if (gr d 0) (block Nil (setq dmg (add dmg d)) (objRepairArmor gPlayerShip seg))) )) (if (gr dmg 0) (txBotSet 'damageTaken (add (or (txBotGet 'damageTaken) 0) dmg))) (shpRechargeShield gPlayerShip) )) ))
; --- one step per OnGlobalUpdate (setq txBotStep (lambda () (block (phase idx) (setq phase (txBotGet 'phase)) (setq idx (or (txBotGet 'idx) 0)) (switch (not gPlayerShip) Nil
(not phase) (block Nil (txBotSet 'pass 0) (txBotSet 'fail 0) (txBotLog "START" (cat "system " (sysGetName) " node " (sysGetNode) ", ship " (txBotName (objGetType gPlayerShip)))) (txBotNext (if (eq txBotMode "ship") "shipcheck" "ext")) )
; --- ship-selection mode: the chosen starting ship must be usable (eq phase "shipcheck") (block (cls armor devices) (setq cls (objGetType gPlayerShip)) (if (and txBotShip (!= cls txBotShip)) (txBotFail "ship selection" (cat "asked for " (txBotHex txBotShip) ", got " (txBotName cls)))) (if (typGetImageDesc cls) (txBotPass) (txBotFail (cat "ship " (txBotName cls)) "has no image")) (setq armor (count (objGetItems gPlayerShip "aI"))) (setq devices (count (objGetItems gPlayerShip "dI"))) (if (gr armor 0) (txBotPass) (txBotFail (cat "ship " (txBotName cls)) "no armor installed")) (if (gr devices 0) (txBotPass) (txBotFail (cat "ship " (txBotName cls)) "no devices installed")) ; a new game must start with a full (or nearly full) reactor (block (fuel maxFuel) (setq fuel (objGetProperty gPlayerShip 'fuelLeftExact)) (setq maxFuel (objGetProperty gPlayerShip 'maxFuelExact)) (txBotLog "FUEL" (cat (txBotName cls) ": " fuel " / " maxFuel)) (if (and maxFuel (gr maxFuel 0) (ls (* fuel 10) (* maxFuel 9))) (txBotFail (cat "ship " (txBotName cls)) (cat "starts with low fuel " fuel " / " maxFuel)) (txBotPass))) (txBotLog "SHIP" (cat (txBotName cls) ": " armor " armor segments, " devices " devices, " (count (objGetItems gPlayerShip "wI")) " weapons, cargo " (objGetCargoSpaceLeft gPlayerShip))) (txBotSet 'wait txBotSurvive) (txBotNext "survive") )
(eq phase "survive") (if (gr (or (txBotGet 'wait) 0) 0) (txBotSet 'wait (subtract (txBotGet 'wait) 1)) (block Nil (txBotLog "SURVIVED" (cat txBotSurvive " s with " (txBotName (objGetType gPlayerShip)))) (txBotNext "done") ))
(eq phase "ext") (block Nil (enum txBotExpect u (if (unvIsExtensionLoaded u) (block Nil (txBotPass) (txBotLog "EXT" (cat (txBotHex u) " loaded"))) (txBotFail (cat "extension " (txBotHex u)) "not loaded") )) (txBotNext "types") )
(eq phase "types") (block (all bad) (setq all (typFind "*")) (enum all u (if (isError (errblock (err) (typGetProperty u 'name) err)) (block Nil (setq bad (add (or bad 0) 1)) (txBotFail (cat "type " (txBotHex u)) "typGetProperty name failed")) )) (txBotLog "TYPES" (cat (count all) " types, " (or bad 0) " failed")) (txBotSet 'items (filter (typFind "i") u (txBotInFocus u))) ; a ship class with no image crashes the engine (CIntegralRotation::Update) as soon as one updates (txBotSet 'ships (filter (typFind "s") u (and (txBotInFocus u) (or (typGetImageDesc u) (block Nil (txBotFail (cat "ship class " (txBotName u)) "has no image (spawning it crashes the game); not spawned") Nil) ) ))) (txBotSet 'stations (filter (typFind "t") u (txBotInFocus u))) (txBotLog "FOCUS" (cat (count (txBotGet 'items)) " items, " (count (txBotGet 'ships)) " ships, " (count (txBotGet 'stations)) " stations")) (txBotNext "items") )
(eq phase "items") (block (list) (setq list (txBotGet 'items)) (for i idx (min (add idx 19) (subtract (count list) 1)) (block (u item) (setq u (@ list i)) (setq item (txBotTry (cat "itmCreate " (txBotName u)) (lambda () (block (it) (setq it (itmCreate u 1)) (if (eq (itmGetCount it) 1) it (cat "count is " (itmGetCount it) ", not 1")))) True)) (if (not (isAtom item)) Nil (if item (block Nil (txBotFail (cat "itmCreate " (txBotName u)) item) (setq item Nil)))) (if (and item (gr (itmGetMass item) (objGetCargoSpaceLeft gPlayerShip))) (block Nil (txBotSet 'skipped (add (or (txBotGet 'skipped) 0) 1)) (setq item Nil) )) (if item (block Nil (txBotTry (cat "objAddItem " (txBotName u)) (lambda () (objAddItem gPlayerShip item)) True) (if (and (itmMatches item "d") (@ (objCanInstallItem gPlayerShip item) 0)) (block (installed) (setq installed (txBotTry (cat "shpInstallDevice " (txBotName u)) (lambda () (shpInstallDevice gPlayerShip item)) True)) (if installed (txBotTry (cat "shpRemoveDevice " (txBotName u)) (lambda () (shpRemoveDevice gPlayerShip installed)) Nil)) )) (errblock (err) (objRemoveItem gPlayerShip item) Nil) )) )) (if (geq (add idx 20) (count list)) (block Nil (txBotLog "ITEMS" (cat (count list) " item types done, " (or (txBotGet 'skipped) 0) " too heavy for the hold (add/install not tested)")) (txBotNext "ships")) (txBotSet 'idx (add idx 20))) )
; ships: even idx spawns a pair, odd idx (8 s later) removes it (eq phase "ships") (block (list wait) (setq list (txBotGet 'ships)) (setq wait (txBotGet 'wait)) (switch (geq idx (count list)) (block Nil (txBotCleanup) (txBotLog "SHIPS" (cat (count list) " ship classes done")) (txBotNext "stations"))
(and wait (gr wait 0)) (txBotSet 'wait (subtract wait 1))
(txBotGet 'spawned) (block Nil (txBotCleanup) (txBotSet 'idx (add idx 2)))
(block (a b uA uB) (setq uA (@ list idx)) (setq uB (@ list (min (add idx 1) (subtract (count list) 1)))) (setq a (txBotTry (cat "sysCreateShip " (txBotName uA)) (lambda () (sysCreateShip uA (txBotFar 30 220) 0x00001003)) True)) (setq b (txBotTry (cat "sysCreateShip " (txBotName uB)) (lambda () (sysCreateShip uB (txBotFar 30 260) 0x00001005)) True)) (txBotTrack a) (txBotTrack b) (if (and a b) (block Nil (txBotTry (cat "attack order " (txBotName uA)) (lambda () (shpOrder a 'attack b)) Nil) (txBotTry (cat "attack order " (txBotName uB)) (lambda () (shpOrder b 'attack a)) Nil) )) (txBotSet 'wait 8) ) ) )
(eq phase "stations") (block (list) (setq list (txBotGet 'stations)) (txBotCleanup) (for i idx (min (add idx 4) (subtract (count list) 1)) (block (u st) (setq u (@ list i)) (setq st (txBotTry (cat "sysCreateStation " (txBotName u)) (lambda () (sysCreateStation u (txBotFar (multiply 20 (subtract i idx)) 300))) True)) (txBotTrack st) (if (and st (not (objIsAbandoned st))) (txBotTry (cat "objDestroy " (txBotName u)) (lambda () (objDestroy st)) Nil)) )) (if (geq (add idx 5) (count list)) (block Nil (txBotCleanup) (txBotLog "STATIONS" (cat (count list) " station types done")) (txBotNext "wlabs")) (txBotSet 'idx (add idx 5))) )
(eq phase "wlabs") (block Nil (if (unvIsExtensionLoaded 0xD7897000) (txBotWeaponLabs) (txBotLog "WLABS" "WeaponLabs 51 not loaded, skipped")) (txBotNext "gates") )
(eq phase "gates") (block (gates dest) (switch (geq idx txBotHops) (txBotNext "done")
(and (txBotGet 'wait) (gr (txBotGet 'wait) 0)) (txBotSet 'wait (subtract (txBotGet 'wait) 1))
(block Nil (setq gates (sysGetStargates)) (if gates (block Nil (setq dest (sysGetStargateDestination (@ gates (random 0 (subtract (count gates) 1))))) (txBotLog "GATE" (cat "hop " (add idx 1) ": " (sysGetName) " to " (@ dest 0))) (txBotTry (cat "objGateTo " (@ dest 0)) (lambda () (objGateTo gPlayerShip (@ dest 0) (@ dest 1))) True) ) (txBotLog "GATE" (cat "no stargates in " (sysGetName))) ) (txBotSet 'idx (add idx 1)) (txBotSet 'wait 6) ) ) )
(eq phase "done") (block Nil (txBotLog "DONE" (cat "pass=" (txBotGet 'pass) " fail=" (txBotGet 'fail) " damageTaken=" (or (txBotGet 'damageTaken) 0) " system=" (sysGetName))) (txBotSet 'phase "finished") )
Nil ) ) ))
; WeaponLabs 51 custom builds: the mod's own action codes and CreateWeapon event, one build per chamber, ; then each weapon is fired once with sysCreateWeaponFire at a spawned target (exercises effect XML). (setq txBotWeaponLabs (lambda () (block (savedCursor built target) (setq savedCursor scrGetListCursor) (setq scrGetListCursor (lambda (s) 0)) (setq target (txBotTry "WeaponLabs target ship" (lambda () (sysCreateShip (or (@ (txBotGet 'ships) 0) (objGetType gPlayerShip)) (txBotFar 200 150) 0x00001005)) True)) (txBotTrack target) (for c 0x10 0x1F (block (u) (setq u (txBotTry (cat "WeaponLabs build chamber " (txBotHex (add 0xD7897000 c))) (lambda () (block Nil (rpgD789ClearCBSetWeapon) (CBSetWeapon 'powerUse 0) (CBSetWeapon 'theCost 0) (CBSetWeapon 'listToRem (list)) (rpgD789SetWeaponUNIDs) (rpgD789WeaponMountActionCode 0xD7897020) (rpgD789FireModuleActionCode 0xD7897023) (rpgD789WeaponChamberActionCode (add 0xD7897000 c)) (rpgD789LevelCalibratorActionCode 0xD7897035) (CBSetWeapon 'damage2 (CBGetWeapon 'damage)) (CBSetWeapon 'name (cat "TXBOT test " (CBGetWeapon 'damageText))) (CBSetWeapon 'launcher Nil) (CBSetWeapon 'theFinalCost 5000) (CBSetWeapon 'powerUse3 (multiply (CBGetWeapon 'powerUse2) (CBGetWeapon 'bodyNum2))) (CBSetWeapon 'attributes (rpgIWLSetAttributes (CBGetWeapon 'damageNum) (CBGetWeapon "damg"))) (CBSetWeapon 'repeating "false") (typFireEvent 0xD7897008 "CreateWeapon") (typGetProperty (CBGetWeapon 'unidToUse) 'unid) )) True)) (if (and u (typGetProperty u 'unid) target) (block Nil (setq built (add (or built 0) 1)) (txBotTry (cat "fire " (typGetProperty u 'name)) (lambda () (sysCreateWeaponFire u gPlayerShip (txBotFar 200 140) 0 100 target)) True) )) )) (setq scrGetListCursor savedCursor) (txBotLog "WLABS" (cat (or built 0) " custom weapons built and fired")) ) )) )
